zoomFailed: Could not change page zoom. Please try again.
shortcutsUnavailable: Browser keyboard shortcuts are unavailable. You can still use the toolbar.
clearSiteDataTitle: Clear this Browser resource's site data
clearSiteDataWarning: Closes all pages in this Browser resource, discards unsaved page content, and clears website sign-ins, site storage and cache. This cannot be undone. Other sessions, your system browser, messages, project files and downloaded files are not affected.
clearSiteDataDone: This Browser resource's site data has been cleared.
clearSiteDataFailed: Site data removal could not be confirmed. Some pages may have closed. Reopen the browser before trying again.
addressCopyFailed: Could not copy the page address. Please try again.
externalHandedOff: Sent to your system browser. Its sign-in state is separate; this page remains open here.
externalFailed: Could not open the system browser. Ensure the Agent has stopped and the current page is a web URL, then retry.
openDownloadsFailed: Could not open the system Downloads folder. Check that it is available, then try again.
downloadEmpty: No downloads in this Browser resource
downloadCancelFailed: Could not confirm cancellation. Check the download status and retry when the Agent has stopped.
rebuildWarning: All page tabs will close and unsaved page content will be lost. Session messages and project files will not be cleared.
rebuildFailed: The browser could not be reopened. Ensure the Agent has stopped and finished cleanup, then retry.
addressPlaceholder: Enter a URL or localhost address
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
stopHint: Stop the Agent to browse manually
hostUnavailableHint: The native Browser surface is not available on this device.
requestFailed: The browser could not complete this operation. Retry to reconnect before continuing.
linkLocked: The Agent is running. Stop it, then click the link again to open this page.
linkBusy: The browser is not ready. Click the link again when it is ready.
linkFailed: Could not open the link. The Agent may have started, or the page may be unavailable. Try again when the browser is ready.
linkMapped: This link used {{host}}, a server listening address. Opened its loopback address on this computer.
permissionRetryHint: Website permission was cancelled or denied. Reload the page to request it again.
permissionExpired: This permission request ended or the page changed. Request access again from the page.
startHint: Enter an address above. You can browse directly; the Agent can use the same page only with Browser authorization.
initializationFailed: The built-in browser could not initialize. Restart the application and try again.
